scripts.synth: env -u AWS_PROFILE -u AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID -u AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY -u AWS_SESSION_TOKEN AWS_CONFIG_FILE=/dev/null AWS_SHARED_CREDENTIALS_FILE=/dev/null AWS_EC2_METADATA_DISABLED=true CDK_DISABLE_CLI_TELEMETRY=true EZIL_FOUNDATION_CONFIG=${EZIL_FOUNDATION_CONFIG:-config/foundation.example.json} cdk synth --strict --no-lookups --no-notices --no-version-reporting -q -o cdk.out/foundation
scripts.synth:lifecycle: env -u AWS_PROFILE -u AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID -u AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY -u AWS_SESSION_TOKEN AWS_CONFIG_FILE=/dev/null AWS_SHARED_CREDENTIALS_FILE=/dev/null AWS_EC2_METADATA_DISABLED=true CDK_DISABLE_CLI_TELEMETRY=true EZIL_LIFECYCLE_CONFIG=${EZIL_LIFECYCLE_CONFIG:-config/lifecycle.example.json} cdk synth --strict --no-lookups --no-notices --no-version-reporting -q -o cdk.out/lifecycle --app "npx tsx bin/lifecycle.ts"
scripts.gate: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run synth:all
scripts.synth:identity: env -u AWS_PROFILE -u AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID -u AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY -u AWS_SESSION_TOKEN AWS_CONFIG_FILE=/dev/null AWS_SHARED_CREDENTIALS_FILE=/dev/null AWS_EC2_METADATA_DISABLED=true CDK_DISABLE_CLI_TELEMETRY=true EZIL_IDENTITY_CONFIG=${EZIL_IDENTITY_CONFIG:-config/identity.example.json} cdk synth --strict --no-lookups --no-notices --no-version-reporting -q -o cdk.out/identity --app "npx tsx bin/identity.ts"
scripts.synth:ops: env -u AWS_PROFILE -u AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID -u AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY -u AWS_SESSION_TOKEN AWS_CONFIG_FILE=/dev/null AWS_SHARED_CREDENTIALS_FILE=/dev/null AWS_EC2_METADATA_DISABLED=true CDK_DISABLE_CLI_TELEMETRY=true EZIL_OPS_CONFIG=${EZIL_OPS_CONFIG:-config/ops.example.json} cdk synth --strict --no-lookups --no-notices --no-version-reporting -q -o cdk.out/ops --app "npx tsx bin/ops.ts"
scripts.synth:all: npm run synth && npm run synth:lifecycle && npm run synth:identity && npm run synth:ops
